summary: In the heavy near-null moving-slope normal form, complementary coordinates (T,L,W) make every fixed-T homogeneous (X0,L,W) core uniformly determinant-nondegenerate, and account02/B05 r21 yields a slice contribution proportional to p_T(t)^(1/3). Direct integration therefore requires int p_T^(1/3), which diverges for an explicit legal all-mixed diffuse Hadamard product frame with one source spread over [0,R]. More generally any direct normalized-fiber estimate carrying a positive power of conditional density cap incurs an uncontrolled Renyi-spread factor. This refutes that proof interface only, not QFORM. The source-adapted physical-hub selector must be retained across T before fiber normalization.
